voice.description: A battle-scarred male warrior survivor in his thirties: a deep, gruff, low voice, grim and resolute, few words, grief held back by anger and duty. He speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy game.
